SELECT languages, count(*) AS articles FROM govblock_health.pubmed_articles WHERE languages <> 'eng' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the average interest rate on marketable Treasury debt change from January 2021 to January 2025?

SELECT record_date, try_cast(avg_interest_rate_amt AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_treasury.avg_interest_rates WHERE security_desc = 'Total Marketable' AND record_date IN ('2021-01-31', '2025-01-31') ORDER BY 1
Which New York counties are home to the most power plants?
SELECT county, count(DISTINCT plant_code) AS plants FROM govblock_energy.eia860_plant_y_sheet_plant WHERE state = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Senate candidates in Georgia raise in the 2020 cycle?
SELECT sum(ttl_receipts) AS receipts FROM govblock_fec.candidate_summary WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2020' AND cand_office_st = 'GA' AND cand_id LIKE 'S%'
In which states do nursing homes receive the most health citations?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_healthcitations WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do published applications divide among the broad technology sectors?

SELECT wipo_sector_title AS sector, count(*) AS applications, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_wipo_technology WHERE wipo_field_sequence = '0' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which conditions are studied in the most clinical trials?
SELECT condition, count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_conditions WHERE condition IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
At what annual rate did real GDP shrink in the second quarter of 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS percent_change FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadataq WHERE seriescode = 'A191RL' AND period = '2020Q2'
Which states are federal contractors most often incorporated in?
SELECT state_of_incorporation, count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many nonprofits filed the short Form 990-EZ for tax year 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_990_index WHERE return_type = '990EZ' AND tax_period LIKE '2022%'
Outside the United States, which countries host the most NIH-funded projects?
SELECT org_country, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_country <> 'UNITED STATES' AND org_country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Ohio's 1992 presidential vote went to candidates outside the two major parties?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN party_simplified NOT IN ('DEMOCRAT', 'REPUBLICAN') THEN try_cast(candidatevotes AS double) ELSE 0 END) / sum(try_cast(candidatevotes AS double)), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_elections.medsl_president_returns WHERE year = '1992' AND state_po = 'OH'
Which states recorded the most births in 2024?
SELECT stname, try_cast(births2024 AS double) AS births FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many applications in the examination file went on to issue as patents?
SELECT count(*) AS granted FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE patent_number <> ''
Which audit firms performed the most federal single audits for 2023?
SELECT auditor_firm_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE audit_year = '2023' AND auditor_firm_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many claims does a published patent application carry on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(pub_clm_ct AS double)), 1) AS avg_claims FROM govblock_patents.claims_pgpub_document_stats
Which states have the most colleges and universities?
SELECT stabbr, count(DISTINCT unitid) AS institutions FROM govblock_education.ipeds_hd GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the Highway Trust Fund's balance on September 30, 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS balance FROM govblock_treasury.highway_trust_fund_results WHERE account_desc LIKE 'Balance Sept%30, 2024'
Which parts of the Defense Department paid for research behind the most patent applications?
SELECT level_two AS component, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org WHERE level_one = 'Department of Defense' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent families does SureChEMBL cover?
SELECT count(DISTINCT family_id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents
Which states have the most wind turbines standing?
SELECT t_state, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Materials Project entries are theoretical, with no known lab synthesis?
SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(theoretical AS varchar) = 'true'
Which public schools had the largest enrolments in 2024-25?

SELECT sch_name, st, try_cast(student_count AS double) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in the clinical toxicity set failed trials for toxicity?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_clintox WHERE ct_tox = 1
Which California cities are home to the most NIH grants?
SELECT org_city, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_state = 'CA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many 10-K annual reports were filed with the SEC in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE form = '10-K' AND substr(cast(filed AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2023'
Which counties have the highest share of adults who smoke?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS county, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'CSMOKING' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND year = '2022' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Was unemployment higher in Ohio or in Michigan at the end of 2024?
SELECT series_id, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id IN ('LASST390000000000003', 'LASST260000000000003') AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
